description: Run the "dream cycle": find and merge near-duplicate memories, prune expired/low-quality entries, and update quality scores based on access patterns. Use dry_run=true to preview changes.

dry_run.description: If true, report what would be done without making changes

forgetting_floor.description: Opt-in spaced-repetition prune. When set (0-1), remove weakly-held memories whose retention e^(-Δt/stability) has decayed below this floor. Omit to disable.

max_operations.description: Maximum number of merge/prune operations per run

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

prune_expired.description: Remove memories past their expires_at date

prune_low_quality.description: Remove memories with both low importance and low confidence

similarity_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold for duplicate detection (0.5-1.0)

name: memory_consolidate
